correctness.rationale: Two independently checked face-membership constructions agree on all 8192 subsets, and the dual has face vector (13,78,143,78). A deterministic 3933-pair ordinary matching is acyclic on all 50076 nonempty Hasse covers. The reconstructed exact integer 6x5 Morse differential has rank four and a unit 4x4 minor, implying Smith factors all one, and its attaching vectors yield two S7 summands and one S8. Independent mod-two dual boundary ranks (12,66,76) corroborate the degrees. Direct signed Lefschetz sums over all 78 affine maps give values (-1,2,0,2,0,-3) by multiplier, which force the stated rational characters.

value.rationale: The Paley-13 graph is a canonical self-complementary strongly regular graph with (13,6,2,3) parameters. Its nonshellable ordinary three-cut complex has two adjacent homotopy degrees rather than a sole top wedge, and the two homology groups carry distinct natural affine characters (cyclotomic and sign), an intrinsic structural classification not implied by graph parameters or Betti counts. The exact finite invariant and symmetry module have a mathematical reason to be studied, without invoking an unsupported infinite-family consequence.
